# Neighbour Productions

> A husband-and-wife creative studio helping mission-driven brands tell their story through photography, video, brand strategy, and website development. Tagline: "A creative studio helping the helpers."

Neighbour Productions was founded by Jared and Abigail Sanchez. Jared brings a background in commercial and film production; Abigail is a photographer, director, and brand strategist. They operate as a small, intentional studio — taking on a limited number of projects at a time to stay fully present for each client. Contact: info@neighbourprod.com

## Pages

- [Home](https://neighbourprod.com/): Studio overview, featured work, and services summary.
- [About](https://neighbourprod.com/about): Who Jared and Abigail are, their approach, values, and how they work.
- [Services](https://neighbourprod.com/services): Photography, Video & Film, Brand Strategy, Website Development.
- [Work](https://neighbourprod.com/work): Portfolio grid of completed projects.
- [Contact](https://neighbourprod.com/contact): Project inquiry form and 30-minute discovery call booking.

## Services

### Photography
Portraits that look like the person, not the pose. Campaign images built to hold up past the scroll. Editorial and lifestyle work for brands who'd rather feel real than look polished.
Good for: brand libraries, campaign launches, team and founder portraits, product and lifestyle, editorial features.

### Video & Film
Brand films, commercials, and documentary-style storytelling. Jared's background is in commercial and film work — so clients get a director focused on story and a producer focused on where it lives.
Good for: brand anthems, fundraising films, campaign spots, founder stories, documentary series.

### Brand Strategy
Positioning, messaging, brand personality, and audience definition — led by Abigail. The foundation everything else gets built on.
Good for: new brands, rebrands, mission-driven organizations getting clearer about their voice.

### Website Development
Clean, fast, easy-to-update sites that match the brand. Built to reach people, not just to exist.
Good for: nonprofits rebuilding their digital presence, brands launching, service businesses who need a site that does more than look good.

## Selected Work

### Confluence Portraits
Client: AK Confluence | Category: Photography | Services: Portrait Photography, Creative Direction
A series of honest, vibrant portraits capturing the diverse personalities of the Confluence team in a natural greenhouse setting. The focus was on fostering a comfortable atmosphere for authentic expressions.
URL: https://neighbourprod.com/projects/confluence

### Your Stories
Client: Victims of Homicide (V.O.H.) | Category: Branded Content | Services: Content Strategy, Video Production
A grief support group shares raw, honest testimony about losing loved ones to homicide — navigating the justice system and finding solace in shared understanding. Documentary-style video production.
URL: https://neighbourprod.com/projects/voh

## Studio values

- "We believe no one is born void." — Every person and every mission has something real worth bringing to the surface.
- "We believe in moving forward with honesty." — Upfront about costs, value, and fit. If it isn't serving the client, they say so.
- "We believe in creating the right thing for the right people." — Not the flashiest thing. The thing that actually works.
